purpose: Teach: カーボン/絶頂/アカデミック/水域/右折/前兆/全裸/盲目

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、カーボンナノチューブの応用研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on applications of carbon nanotubes, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm professional inquiry. Steady, unhurried pace. A genuine question, not a test. Open posture — inviting him to expand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、音楽家の絶頂期の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the peak years of musicians' careers.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest. Slight hesitation before answering — not uncertain, but checking that he's answering what was asked. Small, genuine voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、アカデミックな評価基準を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you explored academic evaluation standards in your paper, I thought?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing gently. A hint of curiosity underneath — noticing something. Pause before the question, like she's turning something over in her mind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、領海水域の国際法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, actually my paper was on international law and territorial waters.
lines.style: Clear and direct. A touch softer than before — like he's sharing something he's thought about. No apology, but careful precision in each word.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 交差点の右折事故統計を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also covered intersection accident statistics and right-turn collisions, if I recall?
lines.style: Engaged but measured. Leaning slightly forward — genuinely interested in where this is going. Keeping pace steady, inviting more.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地震の前兆現象研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Right, my paper examined precursor phenomena in earthquake prediction research.
lines.style: Calm, focused. Speaking to something he cares about. Breath steady. Direct eye contact level — no flinching, no overexplaining.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、全裸彫刻の美術史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and the art history of nude sculpture — that was in your paper too, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle but direct. No judgment in the tone, just factual. A slight tilt of understanding — acknowledging the breadth of what he's covered. Warm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、盲目の音楽家の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I covered research on blind musicians and their work.
lines.style: Steady, finishing with quiet assurance. A small breath at the end — like a period being placed. Earnest throughout, no defensiveness. Simple closure.
